title: Notes server generator check
purpose: Isolated engineering input for server generation, no repeat model analysis
scope: One entity, create and list own records
No editing, deletion, attachments, mobile UI or external integrations

functional_requirements.text: Create a note with title 1..100 and text up to 2000 characters
acceptance_criteria: A valid authenticated POST persists and returns 201; invalid fields return 400

functional_requirements.text: Verified demo employee sees only own notes
acceptance_criteria: Bearer is checked server-side; request cannot select the owner; GET excludes other employees

functional_requirements.text: Store data in PostgreSQL and preserve it across server restart
acceptance_criteria: The same row is present in PostgreSQL and GET after restarting only the server
